While you recover from your turkey food coma and start your holiday shopping, the NFL heads to Pittsburgh for the fourth annual NFL Black Friday Game. Two prime AFC teams battle for for domination, while Broncos-Steelers could be a preview of the AFC Championship Game in January . Meanwhile, there might be one or two celebrity sightings during the game too.

How to Watch NFL Black Friday Game 2026 Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Nov. 27

- Matchup: Denver Broncos vs. Pittsburgh Steelers

- Online Streaming: Prime Video

When Does NFL Black Friday Game 2026 Start ?

The NFL Black Friday Game takes place on Thursday (Nov. 27) with the Denver Broncos (7-2) taking on the Pittsburgh Steelers (6-3) at Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Kickoff is at 3 p.m. ET/12 p.m. PT.

What TV Network Features NFL Black Friday Game 2026?

In 2026, NFL Black Friday Game livestreams on Prime Video . The game isn’t available to watch on any broadcast or cable network.

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances NFL Black Friday Game 2026?

The NFL is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance during the game. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, including Pittsburgh Steelers fans Joe Manganiello, Bret Michaels from Poison, Wiz Khalifa and others.

Where to Watch NFL Black Friday Game 2026 Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there’s only one way to watch the NFL Black Friday Game. You’ll need a subscription to Prime Video, which, luckily, comes with a free trial, so you can watch the game for free.
